title: Endpoint compliance and eval-gated scope sheet for unified interaction suite
creator: Aisha Khan
description: This ticket delivers a requirements and acceptance catalog plus a gated launch checklist for the Hosted API interaction surface (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank). The goal is to provide a single source of truth that ties behavioral evals, compliance checks, and cutover actions together so teams can sign off on rollout slices. Scope includes acceptance matrices, eval harness definitions, telemetry thresholds, cutover scripts and rollback triggers. Scope excludes infra provisioning and model training.
acceptance_criteria: Behavioral eval harness implemented and runnable against production traffic shadowing
Acceptance matrix populated for each endpoint type (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) with pass/fail rules
Telemetry dashboards ingest required signals at 1-minute granularity
Canary cutover plan documented with traffic slice definitions and automated rollback policy
SLOs and budgeted cost per 1k tokens defined and validated in staging
Security and compliance checklist signed by InfoSec (SAML/KMS audit items validated)
checklist: Define eval prompt sets and golden-reference outputs for core intents
Create staged rollout runbook with operator steps and SSH/console shortcuts
Publish acceptance matrix to Confluence and tag stakeholders
Lock API surface and freeze non-critical changes 72h before canary
Create GitHub PR with configuration for runtime-1.22 and link to CRs
Coordinate Dedicated capacity reservations for expected canary throughput
Verify function/tool-calling contract tests pass across language SDKs
rollout_steps: Stage: shadow traffic in staging with 10% production traffic replay
Canary-1: 1% live traffic to lane A for 6 hours, measure metrics
Canary-2: 10% live traffic for 1 day with eval gating every 2 hours
Ramp: 25% -> 50% -> 100% in 12h increments with automated health checks
Post-cutover: 72h monitoring window then redact experimental flags
metrics_and_signals: quality-regression score from eval harness (delta vs baseline)
cache-hit ratio and effective tokens saved
risks_and_mitigation: Regression in generation quality — mitigate with eval gating and fast rollback
Unexpected cost spike — enforce token cost budget and throttle lanes
Regional capacity shortfall — reserve Dedicated burst capacity and configure fallback model variants
Telemetry gaps — require replayed production traces before canary
